name: mondrian-split
title: Mondrian Split
description: A De Stijl grid draws itself line by line, fills with primary colors, and one cell expands to take over the frame.
useWhen: A scene change or title should arrive as a De Stijl grid that draws itself and then opens into the next scene.
A bold, flat, art-poster look is wanted.
avoidWhen: A soft, photographic or minimal transition is needed.
You need the color field to match a specific brand palette that is not primary: set the colors explicitly.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Optional text shown inside the expanding cell; leave empty for a plain color field.

variables.label: Splits
variables.description: Number of lines in the grid.

variables.label: Line weight
variables.description: Thickness of the black lines at a 720 px frame height.

variables.label: Expanding cell
variables.description: Which cell expands to fill the frame; 0 is the largest.

variables.label: Expanding cell color
variables.description: Color the expanding cell fills the frame with.

variables.label: Text color
variables.description: Color of the text in the expanding cell.
